reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) + browse-tool, for Nino Chavez
method: Walked this branch's Cloudflare preview 66bee64d (cd983a3), logged-out browser at 1280 and 390 px. /predictions in the off-season (today): title, 'No event is open for picks right now. Props open for the next event once it's on the calendar.', 'Follow @letspepper.open for the next dates.', Season Standings and Power Rankings links; no pick buttons; no horizontal overflow. Prebuilt HTML carries only the title (no event baked in). Server: POST /api/predictions for bell-pepper-open-2026 and jalapeno-open-2026 both return 403 'Predictions are closed for this event'. The open-event board (unchanged markup, event name templated into the props) was exercised through currentPredictionEvent across dates in pnpm test:predictions, which pinning the old behavior fails.
